name: Retention Agent Admin
description: Admin-only Dataverse probes for Knowledge Retention (parity spikes, regression checks). Not attached to the employee interview agent.

authFields.label: Client ID
authFields.description: Application (client) ID of the Azure app registration used for app-only access to Dataverse.

authFields.label: Client secret
authFields.description: Client secret of the Azure app registration.

authFields.label: Dataverse environment URL
authFields.description: Base URL of the Dataverse environment, with no trailing slash (e.g. https://org12345.crm4.dynamics.com).

authFields.label: Tenant ID
authFields.description: Microsoft Entra tenant ID (GUID) of the BASF tenant that hosts the Dataverse environment.

actions.name: Admin: spike joined read
actions.description: SE-3215 spike: compare baseline 3-GET loadChildren against FetchXML+adapter for one interview, including SCHEMA field shape parity and a computeState-style fingerprint (active topic/question, topicQnA). Returns readyToReplaceLoadChildren. Retention Agent Admin integration (Dataverse app-only auth). Not for employee interviews. Provide interviewId or employeeEmail.

inputFields.label: Interview ID
inputFields.description: Optional. GUID of the interview to probe. If omitted, employeeEmail must resolve an open interview.

inputFields.label: Employee email
inputFields.description: Optional. Used only when interviewId is omitted: picks the newest open interview (status < 60) for this email.

actions.name: Admin: spike batch create
actions.description: SE-3215 spike: create throwaway topics/questions via one Dataverse $batch changeset on a disposable interview, then verify post-create SCHEMA shape/lookups/statuses (shapeMatch / readyToReplaceGenerationCreates) before optional cleanup. Retention Agent Admin integration (Dataverse app-only auth). Not for employee interviews.

inputFields.label: Interview ID
inputFields.description: GUID of a disposable open interview that may receive throwaway spike rows.

inputFields.label: Topic count
inputFields.description: How many throwaway topics to create. Defaults to 2.

inputFields.label: Questions per topic
inputFields.description: How many throwaway questions to create under each topic. Defaults to 2.

inputFields.label: Cleanup after
inputFields.description: When true (default), delete the created spike rows after confirmation. Set false to leave them for inspection.
